title: Women's independence and not liking women's lib
summary: Women back then were independent; Hunter says she was always liberated and self-supporting but does not care for women's lib.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: You know, they talk so much now about women's lib and women -- career women, and so forth. It seems to me that back in those days there were a lot of women who were very independent and --
Women were more independent, and had their own way. But I don't care for women's lib.
I've always been liberated. Because I've
always made my own, and you know, I've always been independent and never asked anybody for anything, and never wanted anybody to give me anything.
